name: Shepperton to Weybridge Ferry
summary: The Nauticalia Ferry carries pedestrians and bicycles across the Thames between Shepperton and Weybridge. A ferry has served this crossing for centuries, and today's small boat is both a useful Thames Path connection and a pleasingly old-fashioned experience.
reasonToVisit: A centuries-old pedestrian and cycle ferry crossing between Shepperton and Weybridge
planningDetail: Daily in the main season with a reduced winter service; operates only when weather and river conditions permit
